Encoding: Little-endian source has six int32 header values, then interleaved uint32 RGB ranks. Each channel stores rank >> 10; alpha is 255. The 64 frames are packed vertically into a 64 by 4096 RGBA8 texture.
Statistics: The source is a 64 by 64 by 64 three-dimensional void-and-cluster volume. UE's shader input is 128 by 128 by 64 spatiotemporal blue noise. Dimensions and statistics differ; shader address wrapping and R2 offsets use the actual loaded texture dimensions.
